For issue C, we have selected option C1, as we understand the potential impact on the environment and are willing to work within federal guidelines to minimize any harm.

In terms of compensation to "neighbouring cities", we believe that option D5 is the most appropriate, as we do not believe that the project will have a significant impact on their local tourism.

Finally, for issue E, we prefer option E4, as we believe that all potential employees should have an equal opportunity to work on this project, without any special preferences.

We are confident that this proposal meets the needs of all parties and will lead to a successful and profitable project for everyone involved. Thank you for your consideration.
